verdict.rationale: Runway Dev documents a public HTTP API covering generative video, image and audio models. The docs include usage guides, cURL examples, a task-polling pattern (`GET /v1/tasks/{id}`), and published pricing. Probes confirmed a live llms.txt and a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.1 spec at /openapi.json. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of using the API in practice, since the community evidence covers only the older browser editor.
